L21@P0: Regimen
L22@P0: Code
L23@P0: HSE approved
L24@P0: reimbursement
L25@P0: status*
L26@P0: Pembrolizumab in combination with chemotherapy as neoadjuvant
L27@P0: treatment, and then continued as monotherapy as adjuvant treatment after
L28@P0: surgery, is indicated for the treatment of adults with locally advanced, or
L29@P0: early stage triple negative breast cancer at high risk of recurrence.
L30@P0: C50 00861a ODMS
L31@P0: 01/06/2024
L32@P0: *This applies to post 2012 indications
L33@P0: TREATMENT:
L34@P0: The starting dose of the drugs detailed below may be adjusted downward by the prescribing clinician, using their
L35@P0: independent medical judgement, to consider each patients individual clinical circumstances.
L36@P0: In the neoadjuvant phase, treatment is administered as below, or until disease progression that precludes
L37@P0: definitive surgery or unacceptable toxicity.
L38@P0:  Cycles 1-4 (4 x 21 day cycles) : CARBOplatin and PACLitaxel day 1, 8, 15
L39@P0:  Cycles 5-8 (4 x 14 day cycles): DOXOrubicin and cycloPHOSphamide day 1
L40@P0:  Every 6 weeks: Pembrolizumab (i.e. day 1 of cycles 1, 3, 5, and 8)
L41@P0: In the adjuvant phase, pembrolizumab is administered on day 1 of a 42 day cycle for 5 cycles commencing
L42@P0: 6 weeks after day 1 of cycle 8 above, or until disease recurrence or unacceptable toxicity occurs.
L43@P0: Patients who experience disease progression that precludes definitive surgery or unacceptable toxicity
L44@P0: related to pembrolizumab as neoadjuvant treatment in combination with chemotherapy should not receive
L45@P0: pembrolizumab monotherapy as adjuvant treatment.
L46@P0: G-CSF support (using standard or pegylated form) is required with all cycles of dose dense chemotherapy.
L47@P0-1: Facilities to treat anaphylaxis MUST be present when systemic anti-cancer therapy (SACT) is administered. NCCP National SACT Regimen

L121@P2: 1 1 Pembrolizumab 400mg IV infusion 100mL NaCl 0.9% over 30 minutesa, b 9-13
L122@P2: a Pembrolizumab is diluted to a final concentration ranging from 1-10mg/mL.
L123@P2: b Administer using a low-protein binding 0.2 to 5 micrometre in-line or add-on filter.
L124@P2: Note: Administration volumes and fluids have been standardised to facilitate electronic prescribing system builds.
L125@P2: CARBOplatin dose:
L126@P2: The dose in mg of CARBOplatin to be administered is calculated as follows:
L127@P2: Dose (mg) = target AUC (mg/mL x min) x (GFR mL/min +25)
L128@P2: o Measured GFR (e.g. nuclear renogram) is preferred whenever feasible
L129@P2: o Estimation of GFR may be performed using the Wright formula to estimate GFR or the
L130@P2: Cockcroft and Gault formula to estimate creatinine clearance
L131@P2: o The GFR used to calculate the AUC dosing should not exceed 125mL/min
L132@P2: o For obese patients and those with a low serum creatinine, for example, due to low body
L133@P2: weight or post-operative asthenia, estimation using formulae may not give accurate
L134@P2: results; measured GFR is recommended
L135@P2: o where obesity (body mass index [BMI] ≥ 30 kg/m2) or overweight (BMI 25-29.9) is
L136@P2: likely to lead to an overestimate of GFR and isotope GFR is not available the use of
L137@P2: the adjusted ideal body weight in the Cockcroft and Gault formula may be
L138@P2: considered
L139@P2: o where serum creatinine is less than 63 micromol/L, the use of a creatinine value of
L140@P2: 62micromol/L or a steady pre-operative creatinine value may be considered
L141@P2: o These comments do not substitute for the clinical judgement of a physician experienced in
L142@P2: prescription of CARBOplatin
L143@P2: WRIGHT FORMULA
L144@P2: There are two versions of the formula depending on how serum creatinine values are obtained, by the
L145@P2: kinetic Jaffe method or the enzymatic method. The formula can be further adapted if covariant creatine
L146@P2: kinase (CK) values are available (not shown).
L147@P2: 1. SCr measured using enzymatic assay.
L148@P2: GFR (mL/min) = (6230 - 32.8 x Age) x BSA x (1 - 0.23 x Sex)
L149@P2: SCr (μmol/min)
L150@P2: 2. SCr measured using Jaffe assay
L151@P2: GFR (mL/min) = (6580 - 38.8 x Age) x BSA x (1 - 0.168 x Sex)
L152@P2:  SCr (μmol/min)
L153@P2-3:  Key: Sex = 1 if female, 0 if male; Age in years; BSA= DuBois BSA NCCP National SACT Regimen

L172@P3: ELIGIBILITY:
L173@P3:  Indication as above
L174@P3:  Age > 18 years
L175@P3:  ECOG 0-1
L176@P3:  TNBC as confirmed by validated test method
L177@P3:  Newly diagnosed, previously untreated non-metastatic disease T1c N1-2 or T2-4 N0-2 (AJCC
L178@P3: 7th Edition)
L179@P3:  Adequate haematological, hepatic and renal function
L180@P3: CAUTIONS:
L181@P3:  History of serious autoimmune disease
L182@P3:  Active or unstable CNS metastases
L183@P3:  Immunosuppressive doses of systemic corticosteroids or other immunosuppressive
L184@P3: medication(s) (defined as >10mg prednisoLONE/daily (or steroid equivalent, excluding inhaled
L185@P3: or topical steroids)
L186@P3:  Any active clinically significant infection requiring therapy
